report.scope: Focused test-property corrections explicitly authorized by root; no runtime changes from this agent, no clinical or contact threshold expansion.

priorRuns.retention: Observed tool output transcribed here; full raw output remains in the conversation. Per-run source hash was not captured, so no frozen-source claim is made.

failures.reason: Old test used metacarpal bone plane for flexion although updated recipe explicitly targets the fitted skin plane.
failures.replacement: Use the existing fitted skin normal branch for flexion as already done for extension. Preserve < -0.995 unchanged.

failures.reason: 14cm absolute excursion was an unsupported heuristic tied to the prior penetrating placement. It failed and is not relabelled a pass.
failures.replacement: Require pelvis descent (>0) and reduced distance to bilateral foot midpoint, keeping the existing kneeZ - hipZ >0.3m assertion. Qualitative direction follows the referenced protocol; endpoint feasibility remains separate.

priorRuns.scope: After replacing only the pelvis-drop heuristic; existing ankle-origin check subsequently reached.

failures.reason: Ankle origin lies above the supported dorsal foot/toe skin. The old8cm proxy failed; it did not demonstrate actual surface contact.
failures.replacement: Use existing independently computed >50%foot/toe-weighted skin bounds; abs(minY)<0.001m at setup, assessed and finish, using the predeclared new flexion surface criterion. Preserve the other hand, forearm and geometric checks.

recordings.constraintsDelivery: Restricted limits supplied only to resolveComposedMotion; sampleComposedMotion receives no duplicate constraints.

report.unchanged: Existing prone150micrometre and exchange100micrometre gates, modeled/patient joint bounds, palm2mm drift, kneeXZ5mm and palmnormal?0.995 remain unchanged.
report.limitations: Focused current run covers23 selected tests. The earlier run passed the other79, but final whole-suite, full frozen-source identity, native, clinical and host acceptance are not established here.

limitations: Local authored-playback candidate, not a merged release or a formal catalogue context/defect acceptance. Existing source identities, observations and delivery records require release reconciliation before shipment.
The heel-to-pelvis endpoint gap remains. No quantitative reference trajectory, clinical signoff, native dynamics, compression or whole-foot contact is claimed.
Knee skin and toe skin are the lower support witnesses. The foot region itself remains about22–30mm above the plane.
Default Blender geometry is sampled at30Hz, with27 phase images inspected; this is not continuous event-aware contact validation.

Browser witnesses use the real stage compiled by each host and an independent sampled rig, with a diagnostic mount. They do not establish all product UI paths or rollout of the unchanged original simLAB5173 checkout.

The1mm flexion visual-contact criterion was declared before tuning. Existing prone150micrometre, solver50micrometre and interchange0.1mm gates are unchanged. Historical14cm pelvis-drop and8cm ankle-marker assertions failed and were replaced with explicit task-direction and actual-skin checks; they are not reported as passes.
Original failed evidence, native failures, other movement defects and the isolated extension shipment checkpoint remain retained.
